listening.instruction: 問題1では、まず質問を聞いてください。それから話を聞いて、問題用紙の1から4の中から、最もよいものを一つ選んでください。

options: しゅくだいを出す
パソコンをかたづける
こくばんの字をけす
CDプレイヤーを運ぶ

questions.note: Picture question, 2x2 grid of 4 numbered panels. 1: (left) a bouquet of flowers tied with a ribbon bow, (right) a woven fruit basket with a handle tied with a large ribbon bow, containing an apple, bananas and grapes. 2: (left) the same bouquet of flowers, (right) a tall plastic (PET) bottle with a label showing a round fruit. 3: (left) a book/notebook with a guitar illustration (and a pen/pencil diagonally) on its cover, (right) the same fruit basket with ribbon bow, apple, bananas and grapes. 4: (left) the same book/notebook with guitar illustration on its cover, (right) the same tall plastic bottle.

Picture question. At the top is a whole round cake decorated with strawberries around the top edge. Below are 4 numbered top-view diagrams of the round cake showing dotted cut lines. 1: circle divided by a vertical and a horizontal dotted line into 4 equal quarters. 2: circle divided by 5 radial dotted lines into 5 equal slices. 3: circle divided by a vertical and a horizontal dotted line plus one diagonal dotted line in the upper-right quarter, making 5 pieces (3 quarters and 2 eighths). 4: circle divided by a vertical and a horizontal dotted line plus two diagonal dotted lines in the right half (one in the upper-right quarter and one in the lower-right quarter), making 6 pieces.

options: しりょうをコピーする
へやをよやくする
エアコンをつける
お茶のじゅんびをする

questions.note: Picture with four labelled illustrations above the printed text options: ア a stack of (thick) books; イ a stack of magazines/discs (flat square items, the top one with a circular design, like magazines/CD cases); ウ cooking pots — a lidded cooking pot and a frying pan in front of it; エ a stack of round plates. The printed options are combinations of two labels.

ア エ

listening.instruction: 問題3では、問題用紙に何も印刷されていません。この問題は、全体としてどんな内容かを聞く問題です。話の前に質問はありません。まず話を聞いてください。それから、質問とせんたくしを聞いて、1から4の中から、最もよいものを一つ選んでください。
問題4では、絵を見ながら質問を聞いてください。やじるし（→）の人は何と言いますか。1から3の中から、最もよいものを一つ選んでください。

questions.note: Panel 1番: Office interior with cabinets/desks in the background. Two men in suits are walking side by side; the man on the left is carrying files/a box, the man on the right is gesturing with his outstretched right hand as he walks. The black arrow (やじるし) at the upper right points to the man on the right.

Panel 2番: Room interior. A young man with a backpack is entering through a door on the left, while a woman carrying a shoulder bag stands on the right; a table with a cap on it is in the foreground. The black arrow (やじるし) at the upper right points to the woman standing on the right.

Panel 3番: Hospital room. A woman is lying in a hospital bed on the right, and a man stands beside the bed on the left holding a bag (visiting her); there is a small bedside table with flowers between them. The black arrow (やじるし) at the upper left points to the standing man on the left.

Panel 4番: Station-like interior with ticket gates visible on the left in the background. A man in a suit carrying a bag is walking in the centre while talking on a mobile phone, with a hurried/worried expression. The black arrow (やじるし) at the upper left points to this man in the centre.

listening.instruction: 問題5では、問題用紙に何も印刷されていません。まず文を聞いてください。それから、そのへんじを聞いて、1から3の中から、最もよいものを一つ選んでください。
